name: Kurano Yae
source:
Kazuya's younger sister and the twin sister of [url=http://vndb.org/c10104]Ema[/url]. She's a first year student in high school. She acts very shy but is comfortable around her siblings. She and Kazuya take the role of being the main chefs of the pastry shop with their parents gone.

She has the exact same eye color as her twin sister Ema.
